narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The factors are only the primes, three and five!
<bookmark mark='nine'/>But two hundred and twenty five divided by nine is exactly twenty five.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Nine is a factor of it, and nine is not a prime.

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Multiply the primes one, two, three and then all four at a time, and then add one.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Ninety eight is two times seven times seven, so list all of its factors.
